title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Customize how citations are included when copying responses
summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot will add a customizable "Copy with sources" option by mid-December 2026, letting users choose whether to include citations when copying responses. It is enabled by default but can be turned off to copy text without citations. No admin action is needed.
body:
[What and why]

We are introducing a new option in Microsoft 365 Copilot that lets users choose whether to include citations when copying Copilot responses. This gives users more control over how they reuse Copilot-generated content and reduces the need to manually remove citations.

[Rollout schedule]

- General Availability (Worldwide): Rollout will begin in mid-December 2026 and is expected to complete by late December 2026.[Impact on your organization]

Who is affected

- Microsoft 365 Copilot usersPlatforms and services

- Microsoft 365 CopilotWhat will happen

- The Copy with sources option allows users to include citations with copied content, making it easier to preserve and reference the original sources. Users can customize whether citations are included when copying Copilot responses.

- Copy with sources is enabled by default. Users can turn off Copy with sources to copy text without citations, eliminating the need to remove them manually.

[Action required and recommendations]

No administrator action is required. We recommend that you inform users about the new option for copying Copilot responses.

[Compliance considerations]

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
